mentions.name: Warhammer 40k RTS rules-engine
mentions.description: A rules engine for Warhammer 40k that lets players run games RTS-style in the browser. It features a highly modifiable architecture to handle the game's thousands of army-specific special rules, with future plans for public lobbies and matchmaking (like chess.com for WH40k).
mentions.problem: Warhammer 40k has thousands of special rules across all armies and no existing browser-based way to play RTS-style, so the builder set out to tackle it themselves after waiting for someone else to do it.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently started building a rules-engine for Warhammer 40k, so that I can finally play a game RTS-style in the browser.
